{{Quote|&hellip; Imperial fuel container ''Transtom'' destroyed en route to main fleet &hellip;|Excerpt from Imperial Commission on the Conduct of the War report "Effectiveness of Standard Escort and Patrol Tactics Against Enemy Interdiction"|<ref name="SWS" />}}
The '''''Transtom''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[fuel container]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was destroyed while en route to the main [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. Its loss was reported in the [[Imperial Commission on the Conduct of the War]].
